reviews.title: Really one of the few!!!
reviews.text: They’re very few apps that actually pay out money. They say that they’re gonna give you thousands or hundreds of dollars, more money they say they’re gonna give you the more they’re fake, but this app is real. It’s actually fun. It kills time and it gets you healthy.  I just found out about these apps a little while ago. I’ve gotten screwed a few times when I played for four days for hours a day to get 120 bucks and ended up getting nothing except looking at a pig that turned gold be careful with what you choose. Look up reviews online that’ll tell you what’s good.

reviews.title: Not worth your time
reviews.text: The first day I downloaded this, I watched ads for about 1 hour, got $2.  Then I was like, hmm okay I’ll just keep doing that as I do other stuff.  Well the next day I watched ads for 3 hours, thinking I’d get like $6.  I had quadrupled my points or gems, or whatever they are, so I thought I’d get more than the first time.  But I was wrong, I got about 15 cents for wasting 3 hours, and having way more points than my first time.  I believe it’s there way to reel people in, but then they give you a lot less after the first withdrawal, or 24hrs.  Idk.  The cashout is real.  Sent directly to my PayPal, but it’s not worth your time.  Go download WeWard.  I’ve had premium membership with them, it’s roughly $40 a year, but after my first week I already made $20 just from walking and playing a few games here and there.  Way more worth your time, even if it’s just walking, i roughly get 50 cents to a dollar every day from walking, and there’s no ads with WeWard just to claim your steps.

reviews.title: Stopped working and no CS
reviews.text: It worked for a little while. You earn very little, but every penny adds up, in my opinion. I’ve been using the app for a couple of months. In June I tested if it would actually pay out. I cashed out $.05 with no issues. So I thought great so I will build up, save and once I need $1.50 or so I will cash out. I have other similar apps that help me get off my disabled rear end  and earn a few Pennie’s at the same time. Put them all together I have a few bucks to spend. I’ve gotten this app to $1.92 by August 1. I tried to cash it out. The hydration app I use by this same developer cashed out just fine (approx the same $ amount as this app), and now it says that there is a network error. I have sent emails to the address given in the error box, and sent emails through the app support button here in the App Store and I’ve gotten no response. I’ve done every update they create and still no fix for this issue.
